items.q: 1. Do you remove all types of refrigerators?
a: Yes! We remove all types – standard fridges, mini-fridges, side-by-sides, and residential units. No fridge is too big or small for our professional removal team.

items.q: 2. Will you disconnect my fridge before removal?
a: Absolutely. Our team safely disconnects water lines and power before removal. Just point us to the fridge – we handle everything.

items.q: 3. What happens to my old fridge after removal?
a: We responsibly recycle 90 %+ of materials. Freon is properly recovered, metals are recycled, and usable parts may be donated to local organizations.

items.q: 4. How much does fridge removal cost?
a: Prices vary by fridge size/type. We offer free, no-obligation quotes – just send us details about your fridge for an accurate estimate.
